issues.reason: A spring tide at new moon is a conceivable counterexample, so the dial gives empirical confidence 0.9 ('when unsure → empirical') and a quantifierless generic takes strength 0.9, making (STV 1.0 0.99) unlicensed.

The decomposition mandate covers predicate/class/property/action compounds, not Time-slot constants (compound deictics like last_week are never decomposed), and the genus is anyway suppressed where the IS-A fails — the phase-as-time full_moon is not a moon, so the demanded (Inheritance full_moon moon) would itself assert a falsehood; the issue mistakes a coverage gap for a defect.

gaps_confirmed: 'at full moon' — a recurring astronomical phase as a temporal adjunct: the Time section does not say whether it is a bare Time symbol, a frequency slot, or a whenever-rule trigger
new_gaps: whether a fused phase-as-time symbol (full_moon / new_moon) owes decomposition atoms is unspecified — time constants are nowhere decomposed, and any licensed form would need a genus that survives the IS-A test

the light-verb generic composition ('Ns occur at T') — quantifying over instances of an eventuality kind with Time on the domain variable — is unaddressed (the light-verb rule is stated only for a specific event-noun witness)
defect_summary: For the confirmed truth-value issue the compliant form is the same rule at (STV 0.9 0.9); the refuted decomposition issue requires no change.
notes: The no-reification light-verb treatment with Time riding the spring-tide instance itself is acceptable improvisation in the identified gap.
